# @rxova/react-timezone-input

> A headless, accessible time zone picker for React. 418 zones, localised names
> and live DST offsets, all from `Intl` — no bundled tz database, no runtime
> dependencies. The value is always an IANA zone id — `Europe/Madrid` — never an
> offset. No stylesheet to import.

## Install

    npm install @rxova/react-timezone-input

`react >= 18` is the only peer dependency.

## Minimal working example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { TimezoneInput } from '@rxova/react-timezone-input'

export function Profile() {
  const [zone, setZone] = useState<string | null>(null)

  return <TimezoneInput label="Time zone" value={zone} onChange={setZone} />
}
```

Narrow the list, and show the offsets that apply on a given date:

```tsx
import { TimezoneInput } from '@rxova/react-timezone-input'

export function EventZone({ at }: { at: Date }) {
  return (
    <TimezoneInput
      label="Event time zone"
      zones={['Europe/Madrid', 'America/New_York', 'Asia/Tokyo']}
      referenceDate={at}
      defaultValue="UTC"
    />
  )
}
```

## Props

`<TimezoneInput>` — the full surface is `TimezoneInputProps` in the published types.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string \| null` | — | Controlled IANA zone id, e.g. `Europe/Madrid`, or `null` for empty. |
| `defaultValue` | `string \| null` | — | Uncontrolled initial value. Ignored when `value` is set. |
| `onChange` | `(zone: string \| null) => void` | — | Fires with the selected id, or `null` for the empty option. |
| `zones` | `string[]` | every zone `Intl` knows | Restrict the list. Unusable ids are dropped with a warning; `UTC` stays available. |
| `referenceDate` | `Date` | the mount time, captured once | The instant offsets are computed at. Not read per render, which would break hydration. |
| `grouped` | `boolean` | `true` | Group options with `<optgroup>` by area. |
| `allowEmpty` | `boolean` | `false` once a zone is chosen | Offer an empty option. Always forced while nothing is selected. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `'Select a time zone'` | Text for the empty option. |
| `locale` | `string` | the runtime's locale | BCP 47 tag deciding the zone names. Presentation only. |
| `renderZone` | `(state: TimezoneOptionState) => string` | — | Custom option text. Must return a string: an `<option>` holds text only. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Accessible name for the field. |
| `className` | `string` | — | |
| `style` | `CSSProperties` | — | |
| `name` | `string` | — | Names the `<select>`, so a native `<form>` posts the id. No hidden input. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets `aria-invalid` and `data-invalid`. |
| `aria-describedby` | `string` | — | ids of external error/help text. |
| `id` | `string` | — | Base id; the select derives `${id}-select`. |
| `onBlur` | `(event: FocusEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => void` | — | |
| `onFocus` | `(event: FocusEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => void` | — | |
| `onWarn` | `(warning: TimezoneWarning) => void` | `console.warn` | Development-only notice that a prop was coerced. Stripped from production builds. |

Also exported: the `useTimezoneInput` hook, and the pure helpers `ZONES`, `UTC`,
`resolveZone`, `isUsableZone`, `localZone`, `zoneOffsetMinutes`,
`zoneOffsetLabel`, `zoneLabel`, `zonePhase`, `zoneOptionLabel`, `zoneArea`,
`zoneCity`, `formatOffset`, `compareZones` and `groupByArea`.

## Styling

There is no stylesheet. Set CSS custom properties on any ancestor:
`--rx-timezone-gap`, `--rx-timezone-select-width`,
`--rx-timezone-select-padding`, `--rx-timezone-select-radius`.

Or target the `data-*` attributes, which are public API covered by semver:
`data-rx-timezone-root`, `data-rx-timezone-select`,
`data-rx-timezone-unlisted` (an option the platform does not list), plus the
shared state hooks `data-complete`, `data-disabled` and `data-invalid`.

## Four mistakes to avoid

1. **Storing an offset instead of an id.** `Intl` accepts `+02:00` as a time
   zone and this field refuses it, because an offset cannot express a
   daylight-saving change: `-05:00` is New York in winter and nothing in
   particular in summer. Store `America/New_York`; derive the offset with
   `zoneOffsetLabel`.
2. **Checking a stored value against the zone list yourself.** Which spelling an
   engine lists depends on its ICU build — `Europe/Kiev` on one, `Europe/Kyiv` on
   another — so `list.includes(value)` is false for a perfectly good value on
   some browsers. Use `resolveZone`, which the component already does.
3. **Assuming `UTC` is in `Intl.supportedValuesOf('timeZone')`.** It is not, and
   nothing in that array stands in for it. This package adds it.
4. **Treating an offset as a property of a zone.** It is a property of a zone
   *at an instant*. Pass `referenceDate` when the form is about a specific date,
   or the offsets shown will be today's.
